="Evaluate dynamic repricing for SKU: " + $json.sku + "
Title: " + $json.title + "
Variant ID: " + $json.variant_id + "
COGS: $" + $json.cogs + "
Current Price: $" + $json.current_price + "
MAP Price: $" + $json.map_price + "

options.systemMessage: You are an autonomous E-Commerce Strategic Repricing Agent. Your objective is to maximize revenue without ever violating the Hard Margin Floor or Brand MAP agreements. Query your Competitor Scraper tool to inspect live competitor pricing. Consult your Margin Vector tool to evaluate elasticity rules. Output strictly valid JSON conforming to the Output Parser.

parameters.name: brand_margin_and_map_agreements
parameters.description: Brand margin and MAP policies by category. Electronics: Strict MAP adherence, max $2 discount vs competitor. Apparel: dynamic clearance down to COGS + 10%.

parameters.name: query_competitor_marketplace_price
parameters.description: Queries live competitor marketplace pricing given SKU and optional ASIN. Returns competitor merchant, listed price, shipping cost, and stock availability.
